title: Women in War
paragraphs: Those were the times Womenfolk were held in regard and concern And given due respect for their softness of disposition;
They were therefore kept off places of danger. Their duties were restricted to work off the warfront And to war camps.
The culture in this regard hasn’t changed; What is witnessed today is only a reformulation of things.
> The union of love will be kept off > From the war-camp, the place of onerous charge. > > Women assigned to duties other than love > Would be there around in war-camps.
